newsitem.title: USA: Beckley Bancorp sets special $0.08-shr div.
newsitem.headline: Beckley Bancorp sets special $0.08-shr div.

text.p: Beckley Bancorp Inc said it declared a special cash dividend of $0.08 per share, payable February 18 to shareholders on record as of January 31.

The company, which is the holding company of Beckley Federal Savings Bank, said the special dividend is in addition to its regular semi-annual cash dividend of $0.14 per share, also payable February 18 to shareholders on record as of January 31.
The company said in a statement it does not expect to pay the special dividend on a regular basis. It also said it would release its fourth-quarter results within the next ten days.
